title: Built to change
sub: Platform and solution architecture, a series on the data platform and what is built on it: build or buy, lock-in, open formats and seams, a stage and a date for every technology, an exit plan tested once a year, and the whole data practice on one map, from a data product's owner to its files.
howto: Technology green is a platform, and blue an application, a data product or a team. A gold tag is an owner in the business. Red is a lock, a cost or what can't come out; a green tick, what passed. Amber, a lantern's colour, is the road, its stations, and what the utility keeps as its own.
